children: According to CNBC, COP31 negotiations continued into Saturday, after the summit was scheduled to end on Friday, with nearly 200 countries divided over fossil fuels and climate finance. European Union Climate Commissioner Wopke Hoekstra told reporters the outcome would be either a good deal or no deal. A draft published on Thursday removed earlier references to ending fossil fuel use and dropped a proposed $120 billion target to help developing countries adapt to climate change; no revised text was available by Saturday afternoon.

title: COP31 Climate Summit Risks Failure as Talks Stretch Into Overtime
